name: Shirasawa Maki
source:
A rookie painter.

Because of her reserved personality, she has a hard time engaging in conversations with others. However, she becomes very active when she paints, that she's like a different person.

She devotes herself to art, and so when she starts painting, she tends to neglect her meals and the like. 

Even if she manages to save up some money, she uses it to replenish her art supplies, and so she's barely able to buy stuff necessary to live.

To have some money for living, or rather for buying art supplies, she worked various part time jobs before, but for some reason, she doesn't last long. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.guilty-soft.com/product/yobai4/chara.html]Official Site[/url]]
